name: Lim Wei Loong
bio:
Lim Wei Loong's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not through racing, but through a deep fascination with the precision engineering that underpinned it all. After graduating from the National University of Singapore with a degree in Mechanical Engineering, he initially worked in the aerospace industry, honing his skills in quality assurance. However, the roar of engines always resonated more deeply. He transitioned to motorsport, bringing with him a relentless focus on detail and a commitment to pushing boundaries.

At Reiza Studios Factory, Wei Loong is known for his uncompromising standards. He believes that success hinges on meticulous preparation and relentless pursuit of perfection. He's not afraid to challenge the status quo, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve vehicle performance and reliability. His blend of technical expertise and management acumen makes him an invaluable asset, ensuring that every component and process meets the highest standards before hitting the track. Wei Loong's loyalty to Reiza Studios is unparalleled; he sees the team as his family and dedicates himself to their collective success. He is driven to ensure that Reiza maintains its reputation for quality and performance.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A lean man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on personally inspecting the torque settings on every wheel nut.
